scope: Laphroaig 12 Year Old Global Travel Exclusive, 46%, 700ml only. Research handoff; no runtime, image-manifest, matching or price changes.
sourcePolicy: Producer product page and bottle labels establish facts and tasting notes. Dailyshot establishes the exact public product identity only; no price was saved or updated.

entries.name: Laphroaig 12 Year Old Global Travel Exclusive
entries.maturation: Fully matured in American oak ex-bourbon barrels

sources.evidence: Producer identifies the 12 Year Old Global Travel Exclusive, maturation exclusively in American oak ex-bourbon barrels, no chill filtering and no added colour. The official front and rear bottle images both visibly state 700ml and 46%. The front additionally identifies age 12 and the travel-exclusive presentation.

Public product title is 라프로익 12년 / Laphroaig 12yo. Information lists 700ml, 46%, single malt whisky, Scotland and Islay. Product thumbnail visibly shows age 12 and the travel-exclusive wording on both bottle and box, matching the official presentation.

entries.proposedDescription: 아메리칸 오크 버번 캐스크에서 12년 숙성한 여행 소매점 전용 싱글몰트. 냉각 여과와 색소 첨가 없이 46%로 병입하며, 바다 향과 피트 연기에 과일과 바닐라가 겹친다.

proposedNotes.nose: 바닷소금과 해초, 조린 청사과와 헤더 꿀에 바닐라·페이스트리·헤이즐넛, 말린 오렌지 껍질과 피트의 잔불
proposedNotes.palate: 약품을 연상시키는 향과 소금기 있는 해초, 모닥불에 블랙커런트·핵과일·타임·감초
proposedNotes.finish: 달콤하고 강렬한 감칠맛에 요오드와 기름진 고등어를 떠올리게 하는 여운

notesProvenance.scope: Concise Korean paraphrases of the exact 12 Year Old Global Travel Exclusive page's Nose, Palate and Finish sections. Preserves the earlier verified proposal; rechecked against the current producer page. No retailer or personal-review tasting notes used.

photoCandidates.labelEvidence: Front bottle label visibly reads LAPHROAIG, age 12, EXCLUSIVE TO TRAVELLERS, 700ml and alc. 46% vol. Single bottle cutout; no box or scenic background. The exact front bottle image is linked from the official product-page gallery.

rearLabelCorroboration.labelEvidence: Rear label identifies the 12-year-old whisky and clearly shows 700ml and alc. 46% vol. This corroborates the same values visible on the new front image.

dailyshot.name: 라프로익 12년
dailyshot.evidence: Public Information section explicitly lists 700ml and 46%. Product image confirms age 12 and travel-exclusive bottle/box identity. URL product ID 36582 is the catalog identity; seller-specific query parameters are not needed for the mapping.
dailyshot.imageEvidence: Bottle and box both visibly show age 12 and travel-exclusive wording, with the same white-and-green presentation as the official front. Small ABV/volume text is not used as sole evidence; those values are explicit in the page Information section.

cautions: The preferred asset is the official front bottle image; the old cached file laphroaig-12-travel.webp is a rear-label photo and should not be used as the catalog hero.
Do not confuse this release with Laphroaig 10 Year Old Cask Strength Batch 12 or independently bottled 12-year-old Laphroaig.
The producer page supplies no bottling year; the image-upload directory date is not a release or bottling date.
